limits: Exploratory single runs after initial repeated NFS campaign; not publication-quality estimates.

Completed copies independently content checked. Metadata scope and missing records are explicit per row: remote file mtimes to whole seconds; filesystem copies additionally mode, uid/gid and directory times.
Whole-command time includes tool-native checksumming but excludes harness verification and cleanup. No final durability flush.
Fixture fadvise is advisory; metadata caches warm; NFS server cache and other clients uncontrolled. Tmpfs data remains memory-resident.
Fast-fabric receiver was busy before screening (load average 77.19 / 84.13 / 90.60). No idle-host peak is established.
Fast tmpfs workloads include one extra empty O_DIRECT probe created by the harness; result file counts include it.
LAN fixed runs used WAN-forwarded authentication; LAN keyed runs used a restricted local key. Do not interpret the former as clean LAN timings.
Original fast-8g SFTP attempts used an overly short idle timeout and failed during destination hashing. fast-corrected-8g restores normal IO timeout.
WebDAV with zero request pacing failed concurrent directory creation in lan-pacer-small. Keep failures and timeouts distinct from completed transfers.
The fast-fabric syq path used eight rail addresses automatically; rclone targeted one 400Gb/s rail. The management-LAN receiver used a 2x10Gb/s management bond.
Sizes, directory layouts and settings vary by scenario; compare tools within a scenario. A selected setting is only best among those tested.
WAN payloads are too small and startup-heavy to establish sustained throughput or a fully tuned ranking.

Original operational logs and exact infrastructure identifiers are private. This sanitized extract preserves timings, commands with endpoint placeholders, verification, workload and protocol. The experimental harness revision is retained privately; its rclone adapters are not yet in the public release.

featured.title: Small files → mounted NFS
featured.workload: 40,000 × 4 KiB files in 256 directories. Local /tmp source → mounted NFSv4.2 destination.
featured.caveat: Three earlier runs per setting. NFS server cache and other clients were uncontrolled; retain the substantial variation.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; round-robin placement in numbered directories. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. NFS server cache was not controlled.

featured.title: Small files ← mounted NFS
featured.workload: 10,000 × 4 KiB files in 256 directories. Mounted NFSv4.2 source → local /tmp destination.
featured.caveat: Initial calibration. Subsecond results are too short to establish a dependable ranking.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; round-robin placement in numbered directories. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. NFS server cache was not controlled.

featured.title: Small files on local RAID
featured.workload: 40,000 × 4 KiB files in 256 directories. Copy between directories on the same XFS RAID filesystem.
featured.caveat: Single runs; metadata caches were warm. This is a filesystem copy, with no SFTP or WebDAV.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; round-robin placement in numbered directories. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm.

featured.title: Large file → mounted NFS
featured.workload: One 2 GiB file. XFS RAID source → mounted NFSv4.2 destination.
featured.caveat: Single runs. Completion does not include a final durability flush. NFS server cache is uncontrolled.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; large files in the source tree. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. NFS server cache was not controlled.

featured.title: Large file ← mounted NFS
featured.workload: One 2 GiB file. Mounted NFSv4.2 source → XFS RAID destination.
featured.caveat: Single runs. Advisory fixture eviction does not establish cold NFS server storage.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; large files in the source tree. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. NFS server cache was not controlled.

featured.title: Large file on the same filesystem
featured.workload: One 2 GiB file. Source and destination on the same XFS RAID filesystem.
featured.caveat: Kernel-assisted copying can avoid moving all payload bytes through user space and may share extents. Do not interpret this as physical disk bandwidth.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; large files in the source tree. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm.

featured.title: Small files between nearby servers
featured.workload: 1,000 × 4 KiB files. XFS RAID → XFS RAID, approximately 0.2 ms RTT; receiver has a 2 × 10 Gb/s bond.
featured.caveat: Local SSH key, with source-restricted authorization. WebDAV failed endpoint validation before the copy; it has no comparable time in this run.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; round-robin placement in numbered directories. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm.

featured.title: Fast fabric: one large file
featured.workload: One 8 GiB file, tmpfs → tmpfs between servers in the same data center.
featured.caveat: Receiver was busy. syq used eight rail addresses; rclone targeted one 400 Gb/s rail. Includes an extra empty fixture probe. Normal rclone IO timeout restored after an earlier hashing failure.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; large files in the source tree. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. Tmpfs remained memory-resident; the original fixture also included an empty O_DIRECT probe file.

featured.title: Fast fabric: eight large files
featured.workload: Eight × 1 GiB files, tmpfs → tmpfs on the same fast-fabric hosts.
featured.caveat: Receiver was busy. Eight syq rail addresses versus one rclone 400 Gb/s rail. Includes an extra empty fixture probe. This does not establish an idle-host peak or the cause of the speed difference.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; one large file per numbered directory. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. Tmpfs remained memory-resident; the original fixture also included an empty O_DIRECT probe file.

featured.title: Fast fabric: 32 large files
featured.workload: 32 × 256 MiB files, tmpfs → tmpfs on the same fast-fabric hosts.
featured.caveat: Same unequal rail selection and busy receiver. Includes an extra empty fixture probe. WebDAV was much slower here; the cause was not established.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; one large file per numbered directory. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm. Tmpfs remained memory-resident; the original fixture also included an empty O_DIRECT probe file.

featured.title: WAN: small files — inconclusive
featured.workload: 256 × 4 KiB files in eight directories. Workstation → remote XFS RAID, approximately 265 ms RTT.
featured.caveat: Startup-heavy single runs; neither tool was fully tuned. These are not reliable evidence of sustained WAN throughput. SFTP was stopped at the 60-second screening limit.

preparation.original: Original screening: generated pseudorandom file contents with seed 9911; round-robin placement in numbered directories. The harness generated data with O_DIRECT where supported and requested fixture-page eviction with fadvise; metadata caches stayed warm.

featured.title: WAN: one file — inconclusive
featured.workload: One 64 MiB file. Workstation → remote XFS RAID, approximately 265 ms RTT.
featured.caveat: Too little data to separate startup from sustained throughput. syq logs show 7.34 seconds elapsed before payload planning finished. No WAN capacity baseline or full tuning sweep.
